people.role: Clerk of the Counting House's trade office at Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: Rubs the callus on his forefinger when he lies.
people.backstory: He keeps the trade office's books below the old seat and has twice carried Trầm Tịch Dương's (tram_tich_duong) sealed purchases to Kim Vạn Lý's counter without reading them; he has read the totals, and told Kim's clerk for a cask of wine how many notes the old man buys, so Kim now charges him a tenth over.

people.role: Reads the oath contracts aloud at sunset for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: A rich carrying voice from a small dry frame.
people.backstory: A Vật Hoa Thị broker's daughter who reads every disciple's oath of entry aloud as the sun sets; she has asked Từ Bình Hành (tu_binh_hanh) why the 1179 loan is the one contract the Hall may not read.

ties.note: the clerk who found the vault unopened

people.role: Bridge Hall inner disciple; digs the galleries under the new seat
people.appearance: Rock dust ground into his knees.
people.backstory: The grandson of a Vân Gian miner who came down the mountain in 1040, he dug the footings of the Cloud Bridge Array for Quách Tiếp Vân (quach_tiep_van) and would bring the whole village up to build the outer ring if anyone paid them.

ties.note: she keeps the props he set

people.role: Geese Hall inner disciple; captain of the second line
people.appearance: A dent in her brow where a well-rope slipped.
people.backstory: A Song Tỉnh well-digger's daughter who drills the Geese Hall's second line under Thịnh Kinh Hàn (thinh_kinh_han) and signed the war party's petition for the tolls behind his back; Cảnh Trường Thiên (canh_truong_thien) now believes his drill master wants the Ferry War again, and Thịnh has not found a way to say otherwise.

ties.note: Geese Hall cadet of the war party

people.role: Maple Hall inner disciple; makes the pills that sell against Thúy Vi's
people.appearance: A tea-grower's wide hat tied under her chin with a purple cord.
people.backstory: A Sơn Trà Thôn tea-grower's daughter who entered the inner gate by a single point of Earth, like her master Chử Hồng Diệp (chu_hong_diep), and prices her pills a tenth under Thúy Vi's at every market in the west.

people.role: Boat Hall pilot at Thủy Khẩu; wants a sea boat
people.appearance: A pilot's finger, broken and badly set.
people.backstory: Of the line of the fleet master Hạ Hầu Trường Phong (ha_hau_truong_phong), she pilots river boats for Lô Xướng Vãn (lo_xuong_van) and has asked Lận Viễn Phàm for a berth on his third boat, paying her way by selling the toll-barge counts she takes for Lô; his tolls come up short and Vi Lan Châu (vi_lan_chau) is blamed for the count.

ties.note: the fleet master of the Pirate Purge
who also wants the third boat

people.role: Rider of the Vassal Hall; carries the tribute receipts
people.appearance: A satchel rubbed pale at the clasp.
people.backstory: He carries the eight vassals' tribute receipts for Hách Ánh Hà (hach_anh_ha), and this spring he carries her one list of thirty from Vật Hoa Thị down the steppe road to Cựu Hà Viện for Tô Bình Chu (to_binh_chu) to sign: a month and a half each way, with the children to walk it back by autumn.
people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25 (fixB-5): carries the one list from Vật Hoa Thị (read-pilot-B: no first-draft knowledge)

people.role: Guard of the Miasma Watch; lost two fingers to the grey
people.appearance: Two fingers gone from the left hand; a grey patch on the wrist.
people.backstory: A Xích Thổ herder who left two fingers in the miasma's edge pulling a scout out, he stands with Hình Trọng Sơn (hinh_trong_son) for breaking the Compact and has raised his son to the same; captured treasure-seekers he stakes out at the grey's edge to mark where it has crept, and Mông Thiết Sơn (mong_thiet_son) buries what is left at dawn.

people.role: Watches the Thính Vũ border at the Long River vein
people.appearance: The lamp-counters call him the Owl, for his sleepless face.
people.backstory: Of the house of Trương Ánh Đào (truong_anh_dao), who held Hồng Vũ Thành in the War of the Petal Shore, he watches Thính Vũ's side of the vein for Sử Thu Thủy (su_thu_thuy) and counts its lamps every night.

ties.note: the elder of Hồng Vũ Thành

people.role: Steward of the island hall's stores at Triều Âm Thành
people.appearance: A greenish tinge to her face that never quite leaves it; one hand always finds a rail.
people.backstory: Steppe-born at Liên Chu Thôn and frail and seasick on every crossing, she keeps Lận Viễn Phàm's (lan_vien_pham) stores and his debts, and is the reason the third boat is not yet paid for: she sold the deckhands' winter rice to cover the timber, and they ate boiled rope-weed until spring.

people.role: The sect's own man in the armoury at Tử Điện Thành
people.appearance: Eats, sleeps and argues in his smith's apron.
people.backstory: A descendant of the first armourer Thiệu Song Phong (thieu_song_phong), he works beside the hired smith Vưu Chước Kim (vuu_chuoc_kim) and resents that the sword his ancestor forged woke for a guest; he gives out the good steel to whichever smith brings him wine, and Cổ Tiểu Thiết (co_tieu_thiet) was barred a week for a bent nail.

people.role: Digs the graves on the Evening Isle, facing west
people.appearance: A sailcloth cap tied under his chin; spade blisters on both palms.
people.backstory: He has buried thirty-one elders on the beach of Tịch Chiếu Đảo for Bồ Tàn Chiếu (bo_tan_chieu), and has already dug the keeper's grave and covered it with a sail.

people.role: Holds the dusk test on the steppe at Cựu Hà Viện
people.appearance: A long dry braid, pale eyes narrowed against the sun.
people.backstory: She watches the outer disciples' palms from sunset to full dark and writes down who lets the glow go; every name on Tô Bình Chu's (to_binh_chu) Placement Day list was written by her, and she wrote Uông Tú Ngân (uong_tu_ngan) onto it after one lapse though the girl had held the glow to full dark the week before.

ties.note: the steward of the old seat
who teaches the outer gate with her

tree.intent: Earth glow that holds till dark.

people.role: Caravan master of the steppe road to Vật Hoa Thị
people.appearance: A sheepskin vest over silk, a ring on every finger of the left hand.
people.backstory: He has run the steppe caravans for sixty years and believes the Hạc Đinh road is his, not Lộ Hành Sa's (lo_hanh_sa); he sold mutton to both camps in 1175 at war prices, and bought up the hay at Hạc Đinh so that Lộ's ponies went to market lean.

people.role: Prices the buy-outs for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: Taps an abacus bead before he speaks.
people.backstory: When a disciple wants to buy out the rest of a term, he works the price; he priced Tạ Quy Yến's (ta_quy_yen) at nothing, since Placement Day will sell him anyway, and Tạ has not been able to save a coin toward it.

people.role: Outer disciple who counts faster than the clerks
people.appearance: Her leg jiggles under every desk.
people.backstory: Uông Bình Trù's (uong_binh_tru) daughter, who can add a caravan's manifest in her head and keeps letting the glow go at the dusk test because she cannot sit still till dark.

people.role: Young inner disciple; copies contracts for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: Sleeve cuffs gone grey with copying.
people.backstory: He copies the oath contracts that Kỷ Minh Ước (ky_minh_uoc) reads aloud and has noticed that the copy of the 1179 loan in the register is in the head's own hand.

people.role: Outer disciple from the miners' village of Vân Gian
people.appearance: Walks with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs.
people.backstory: Hạng Kiều Sinh's (hang_kieu_sinh) nephew, who walked down from Vân Gian to the old seat to be tested and wants to come back up to dig the outer ring.

people.role: Geese Hall cadet; the second-best bow
people.appearance: Chapped fisherman's hands that never miss.
people.backstory: A Mã Độ ferryman's son who has lost every archery trial to Thịnh Thiếu Hàng (thinh_thieu_hang) by a hand's width and says the drill master's grandson is judged by his name.

people.role: Geese Hall cadet of the war party
people.appearance: A goose pin and a toll token swing together on one cord.
people.backstory: From Song Tỉnh like Khấu Tịch Nhạn (khau_tich_nhan), she wears a goose pin and a Ferry War toll token on the same cord and wants the tolls back before she forms her foundation; last winter she chained a Tùng Đào toll clerk to the token post for a night of frost, and he lost two fingers to it.

people.role: Outer disciple; sweeps the Maple Hall's drying floors
people.appearance: People forget her plain, kindly face as soon as she leaves.
people.backstory: Quản Đan Phong's (quan_dan_phong) niece, Wood-strong and Earth-thin, who knows she will go to a vassal on Placement Day unless her Earth rises twelve points.

people.role: Outer disciple; plants the Maple Hall's spirit rice
people.appearance: Squats like a rice-planter even in the hall.
people.backstory: A Hòa Lũng farmer's boy who plants spirit rice behind Điền Hòa Lũng (dien_hoa_lung) and would gladly be placed with a vassal if they have fields.

ties.note: placed from Lạc Hà this spring; picks on the Dusk Field

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Boat Hall; sings the fourth verse
people.appearance: A long thin throat that rings like a bell when she sings.
people.backstory: A Vãn Chu Thôn fisher girl who sings the Evening Song's fourth verse on Hạ Hầu Thanh Bích's (ha_hau_thanh_bich) boat and learned it from Thương Ngư Ca (thuong_ngu_ca) on the same jetty.

people.role: Outer disciple from Xướng Vãn Thôn; the choir's youngest
people.appearance: Hums with her mouth closed, as her grandmother does.
people.backstory: Her grandmother in Xướng Vãn Thôn still hums a line of the verse the village stopped singing in 803, and Hồng Vãn Tình (hong_van_tinh) has taken her into the choir to get at it.

people.role: Outer disciple of the island hall
people.appearance: Chart-ink smears on both ears.
people.backstory: A Triều Âm dock boy who copies Luân Hải Yến's (luan_hai_yen) charts by lamplight and means to be aboard the third boat when it sails for the lost fleet.

people.role: Outer disciple of the island hall, due for Placement Day
people.appearance: Bamboo-brown arms; she tries not to smile.
people.backstory: A bamboo-cutter's daughter of Phù Can Thôn with almost no Earth, she expects to be placed with Nhàn Vân Quán and has asked Mạc Triều Sinh (mac_trieu_sinh) to write to her.

people.role: Young inner disciple; runner of the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Draws a miasma scar on his wrist with charcoal each morning.
people.backstory: Đinh Thủ Hoang's (dinh_thu_hoang) son, who runs the Watch's messages with Vũ Tri Thu (vu_tri_thu) and repeats his father's talk of breaking the Compact word for word.

people.role: Outer disciple posted to the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Squats to read the ground.
people.backstory: A Thu Tân shore girl who walks the miasma's edge behind Hàm Tú Sa (ham_tu_sa) and marks with stones where the grey moved each night; it has moved toward the old seat this year.

people.role: Outer disciple at the Long River vein
people.appearance: Knotted cords at her belt, to count lamps by.
people.backstory: Trương Vọng Thành's (truong_vong_thanh) granddaughter, who counts Thính Vũ's lamps beside him and has begun to count the gaps where a lamp should be.

people.role: Works the bellows of the armoury at Tử Điện Thành (servant)
people.appearance: Singed eyelashes.
people.backstory: A Tử Điện dock girl who works the bellows beside Cổ Tiểu Thiết (co_tieu_thiet) and is the only one he told about the sword's hum.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the armoury: a Fire-Metal root the lineage cannot take (R2)

people.role: Outer disciple; rows for her grandfather the isle's ferryman
people.appearance: Has her grandfather's slow, level stare.
people.backstory: Khúc Lão Điếu's (khuc_lao_dieu) granddaughter, who rows the elders to Tịch Chiếu Đảo with him on rest days and has promised Bồ Tiểu Lô (bo_tieu_lo) the second oar on the keeper's last row.

people.role: Outer disciple from Hà Khúc; likely to pass the dusk test
people.appearance: Blushes at praise.
people.backstory: A well-digger's son from Hà Khúc whose palms held the glow to full dark at his first try; Thường Thủ Hà (thuong_thu_ha) has told him not to boast of it to the river children.

ties.note: outer disciple from Liên Chu; a well-digger's daughter

people.role: Outer disciple from Bạch Dương Thôn
people.appearance: Her forehead is pink from practising in the noon sun.
people.backstory: From the same steppe village as her master Thường Thủ Hà (thuong_thu_ha), she has heard that the examiner fails her own neighbours hardest and practises in the noon sun to prove it.

people.role: Outer disciple of Phong Lâm who has failed the dusk test twice
people.appearance: A hopeful smile and maple sap on his cuffs; things tend to fall near him.
people.backstory: A Phong Lâm maple-tapper's son who has failed the dusk test twice and stands in this spring's Placement Day line beside Tạ Quy Yến (ta_quy_yen), hoping for Bình Thủy Môn; his name is on the envoy's list for Thiên Bảo Trai, a Metal house that will never teach him. The roster clerk has lost his name twice, and a cart axle broke at his feet.

people.role: Outer disciple; a hemp-trader's son whose father priced his buy-out
people.appearance: A dice cup rattles in his sleeve.
people.backstory: His father in Tang Ma Thành sold his loom to find the coin to buy out his term, and he has asked Dịch Bách Lý (dich_bach_ly), who buys his father's rope, to keep it from reaching the Hall of Scales, so that he can spend it on dice.

people.role: Outer disciple from Liên Chu; a well-digger's daughter
people.appearance: Red dust on her sandals.
people.backstory: Lục Bồng Sa's (luc_bong_sa) niece, a Liên Chu well-digger's daughter, who holds the glow easily and would rather dig a well than sit in the inner gate.

ties.note: placed from Lạc Hà this spring; weighs ore for the vault book

people.role: Outer disciple; a herder from Ngưu Đẩu Thôn
people.appearance: Straw in his hair, eyelids at half-mast.
people.backstory: A cattle herder from the island grassland of Ngưu Đẩu, where Hách Ánh Hà was born, he sleeps through the dusk practice when Ngạc Viễn Sơn (ngac_vien_son) is not watching.

people.role: Young inner disciple; the youngest witness on the Hall of Scales' seals
people.appearance: Rolls his sleeves to the same fold every day.
people.backstory: He witnesses the sunset seals for Giản Bình Chương (gian_binh_chuong), and Hình Trọng Sơn's war party has asked him, twice and politely, which oaths the Compact can be said to have broken first.

people.role: Young inner disciple at the trade office of Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: Holds one palm flat, as if weighing the air.
people.backstory: She can tell a forged Thiên Bảo note by its weight in her palm, and Uông Bình Trù (uong_binh_tru) has her weigh every note Trầm's go-between brings; the short-weight ones she finds she pays out to the trade office's porters, and keeps the good ones.

people.role: Young inner disciple of the Bridge Hall; carries lamps in the galleries
people.appearance: A limp from a gallery cave-in, lamp-soot in the corners of her eyes.
people.backstory: Quách Tiếp Vân's (quach_tiep_van) grand-niece from Vân Gian, who carries the lamps for Hạng Kiều Sinh's (hang_kieu_sinh) gallery crews and has seen the head's locked door with fresh dust on its sill.

people.role: The head's tea servant (servant)
people.appearance: Stands very still, like someone who has heard everything.
people.backstory: She brewed tea for Tô Vãn Chiếu (to_van_chieu) when the head was a merchant on the river road and carried the same kettle up the mountain in 1185; she tops the head's caddy with spent leaves and sells the good ones, and Trì Vãn Hương (tri_van_huong) is blamed for the thin tea.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the Sunset Hall: a Fire root with Earth under 30 (R2)

people.role: Serves the guest house on the Cloud Bridge (servant)
people.appearance: A face guests forget, and a tray carried exactly at their elbow.
people.backstory: A lamp-maker's daughter of Vãn Đăng Thôn who pours for the guests and tells Trì Vãn Hương (tri_van_huong) every word, adding a line of her own to please her; a Tang Ma buyer was taken for a spy and shut out of the guest house.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the guest house: taken on as staff, not tested for the gate

people.role: Oils the founder's maple stumps at the old seat (servant)
people.appearance: Smells of maple oil.
people.backstory: Taken on as a servant boy at ten, before the last maple died in 1131, he has oiled its stump every autumn since and sits with Hồ Tứ Nương (ho_tu_nuong) in the old seat's kitchen.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of the old seat since childhood; never sat the gate

people.role: Outer disciple; the envoy's grand-niece
people.appearance: A dawn-red ribbon in her braid.
people.backstory: Hách Ánh Hà's (hach_anh_ha) grand-niece from Ngưu Đẩu, named for the dawn to her great-aunt's dusk, who tells the outer gate she will not be sold to the studio, because her great-aunt draws the list; she picks who shares her stove-side bench from a hat of names she has marked, and Cù Bích Trúc (cu_bich_truc) sat by the draughty door all winter.
people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25 (fixB-5): 'will not be sold to the studio' (read-pilot-B)

people.role: Outer disciple from Tân Khẩu; held the rope at the miasma's edge
people.appearance: A rope burn across his left palm that has never closed.
people.backstory: He held the rope the day Đồ Tiểu Liên's (do_tieu_lien) brother walked into the grey, and felt it go slack; he has asked to go with her when she goes back in.
